rule: A deliverable that fails these criteria is fixed in the deliverable, never by relaxing the criteria. Changing this file to make a failing deliverable pass is the framework rewriting the exam because the student failed.

criteria.determinism: same subject twice -> byte-identical exit code and stdout
criteria.false_positive_rate_measured: hand-check every hit up to 25; if total hits < 25, hand-check all of them. Report the count checked alongside the rate. An estimate is not a report.
criteria.real_defect: must flag the defect as it stands at a stable git target in the reference adopter (a pinned commit, not a moving HEAD). For fail-closed: at the two secret-store modules named in `mandatory_green_fixtures` the checker must NOT fire -- both are false positives (handler collects, enclosing code raises unconditionally). Ship them as green fixtures.
mandatory_green_fixtures: reference adopter, secret store (rollback collector, raises outside handler)
reference adopter, second secret store (same shape)

amendment_rule: A criterion may be amended only if its flaw can be stated without reference to any deliverable. If the argument needs 'because submission X failed', it is moving the goalposts wearing a correction's clothes. Amending invalidates every measurement taken under the old criterion -- they are re-run, never grandfathered. Reason is written before re-measuring, not after.
